facts.text: Audrey owns city dogs that enjoy exploring new parks and trails and frequently go on adventures together.

evidence.quote: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.

facts.text: Andrew expresses admiration for animals and mentions that he has always been awed by birds due to their ability to soar and explore new spots.

evidence.quote: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.

facts.text: Andrew mentions that eagles have always mesmerized him because of their strength and grace.

evidence.quote: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
